text: Praise ye Jah. Praise ye Jehovah from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
Praise ye him all his messengers: praise ye him all his armies.
Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise ye him all the stars of light.
Praise ye him, the heavens of heavens, and the waters above the heavens.
They shall praise the name of Jehovah, for he commanded and they were created:
And he will cause them to stand even to forever: he gave a law and it shall not pass away.
Praise Jehovah from the earth, ye dragons and all depths:
Fire and hail, snow and vapor: the spirit of storm doing his word:
Mountains and all hills; the tree of fruit and all cedars:
The beast and all cattle; the creeping thing, and the bird of wing:
Kings of the earth, and all peoples; chiefs and all judges of the earth:
Young men and also virgins; old men with the youths:
They shall praise the name of Jehovah: for his name alone is exalted; his majesty over the earth and the heavens.
And he will lift up the horn to his people, praise to all his godly ones; to the sons of Israel a people drawing near to him. Praise ye Jah.
